entries.description: Read CLAUDE.md, project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, README.md, and the new feedback memory. Noted the 'String In Bytes' Is Not 'Rendered Visible' lesson as binding for the PdfPig assertions.

Added DabblerPdf.Samples/Samples/S11_OrdersStyleReport.cs — landscape 11x8.5, reportHeader written to DirectContent before any NewPage(), pageHeader repeated every page, 4 synthetic customer groups with 48 detail rows, IPdfPageEvent-driven page footer with PdfTemplate for 'Page N of M', explicit navy (#1A1A2E) SetColorFill immediately before the title Tj.
Registered S11_OrdersStyleReport in DabblerPdf.Samples/Program.cs after S10_StressTest.

Ran dotnet run --project DabblerPdf.Samples with an explicit output dir of DabblerPdf.Samples/Output — 11 samples generated cleanly, S11 produced 11-orders-style-report.pdf (5.0 KB). Amended .gitignore to permit committing this one PDF while keeping the rest of Output/ ignored.

Wrote DabblerPdf.Samples/Samples/S11_FINDINGS.md documenting the programmatic (PdfPig-based) signals and handing the final visual sign-off to the human. Orchestrator cannot open a PDF viewer directly; findings frame that honestly.

Added tests/DabblerPdf.Tests/Pdf/OrdersStyleSampleRenderingTests.cs — 6 assertions: ≥3 physical pages; title top-20% bounding box and Helvetica-Bold font; no Page-2-of-N on page 1; exactly one Page X of N per page with correct X and N; rg triple before the title Tj matches navy (26/255, 26/255, 46/255); page 1 also shows column headers and first group. Added a ProjectReference from DabblerPdf.Tests to DabblerPdf.Samples so the test drives the exact sample code path.

dotnet build DabblerPdf.slnx: 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: 614/614 passing (608 pre-session + 6 new). CHANGELOG.md updated with a '1.1.1 verified' note and an Added entry for S11 + companion test.
